title: wildcard * fails whole RR if any array element misses path
description: json_pointer_ext line 155: when token=* and any element returns None, the entire resolution fails. RFC 8620 §3.7 says: 'If the pointer results in an array, the result of the overall ResultReference is...' but is ambiguous on sparse arrays. Current: any element miss = whole fail. If spec intends skip-and-collect semantics, callers get invalidResultReference on valid requests with heterogeneous arrays.
